title: This Is The Problem With AI's Most Bullish Chart
title_cn: This Is The Problem With AI's Most Bullish Chart
summary: It has been a historic week for AI: The Anthropic IPO and the ongoing situation at Nvidia headline a head-spinning time for the industry. Despite Nvidia's earnings outlook looking good, and despite the scale of the Anthropic IPO there are so many open questions about the state of the industry right now. On today's two-part episode, first we speak with Stanley Lee, the chief product officer at Liquid Compute, and he explains why Wall Street and Silicon Valley seem to be talking past each other, and what fragilities are emerging in the credit market for GPUs. All those charts that show rising GPU rental rates, Lee tells us, might not be as industry-bullish as they first appear. Then, we turn to Paul Kedrosky, a managing partner at SK Ventures, and we discuss why “number goes up and to the right” does not necessarily prove the viability of the capex involved in the AI buildout and if Nvidia will remain the central bank for AI. (Source: Bloomberg)
